meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 它把代码库梳理成按功能分组的流程图,找出各功能间重复的逻辑,并给出统一架构提案。产出流程图、重复报告、统一流程图和可直接运行的 /make-plan 提示,本身不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你要求「找到理想路径」、统一重复系统,或在重构前审计架构时接管。

say.text: 帮我把这个代码库映射成按功能分组的流程图
找出跨功能重复的实现,并给出统一架构提案
say.note: 生成重复报告和统一流程图

say.text: 为每个统一后的系统写一份 /make-plan 提示

howto.what_en: It maps your codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, finds duplicated concerns, and proposes a unified architecture. Output: diagrams, a duplication report, a unified flowchart, and /make-plan prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Map this codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts.
Find duplicated logic across features and propose a unified architecture.
Write a /make-plan prompt for each unified system.
